scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Hey, adventurer.
I can take you to somewhere nice. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
嘿，冒险者。
我可以带你去个好地方，你有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Move to Eden Market Group!
scripts.translation: 前往乐园团市场！

scripts.text: About Eden Market Group.
scripts.translation: 关于乐园团市场。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Moving~!
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
搬家咯~！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Hahaha... The Eden Market Group is a place where merchants gather around to sell various items.
And I don't mean common stuff like Jellopy, which you can acquire anywhere. Here, we only deal in real goods.
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
哈哈哈...乐园团市场是商人们聚集在一起，出售各种物品的地方。
而且我指的不是杰勒比结晶这种随处可见的普通货色。这里只交易真正的商品。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Simple ingredients, precious stones, rare items from dungeons and excavation sites, and exotic artifacts that hail from another dimension...
Everything you could ever want!
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
简单的食材、珍贵的宝石、来自地下城和发掘现场的稀有物品，还有来自异次元的奇异文物...
你能想到的一切！

scripts.text: You mean, this is a black market?!
scripts.translation: 你是说，这是黑市？！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Ah... I wouldn't say that.
This marketplace is, say, technically legal...
Keep in mind that most special products are of ^4d4dfflimited quantity^000000. If you are late, they might be sold out.
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
啊...我不这么认为。
这个市场，怎么说呢，在技术上是合法的...
请记住，大多数特殊商品都是^4d4dff限量供应^000000的。如果你来晚了，可能已经卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Don't expect discounts for most limited quantity items.
You have to pay the full price.
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
大多数限量商品不提供折扣。
你必须支付全价。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Adventurers sometimes come by to sell what they have found on their expeditions.
But you have to see for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
冒险者有时会来出售他们在探险中发现的物品。
但你自己得亲眼看看！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Keep in mind that most stores are closed one day out of the week; ^4d4dffmost stores are not open on Wednesdays^000000.
Though, not all of them close on Wednesdays; majority of them are still open.
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
请记住，大多数商店每周有一天休息；^4d4dff大多数商店在周三不营业^000000。
不过，并非所有商店都在周三休息；大多数商店仍然营业。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
More special items are sold on weekends.
I have even seen an {0} being sold~
It was amazing.
Of course it was super expensive and only a handful were up for sale.
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
周末会上架更多特殊商品。
我甚至见过{0}被出售~
太棒了。
当然，它非常昂贵，而且只有少量出售。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
How about it? Interested?
Isn't it worth paying a visit?
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
怎么样？有兴趣吗？
难道不值得去参观一下吗？
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Come by anytime, if you want to go to the Eden Market Group!
scripts.translation:
[骗子]
如果你想前往乐园团市场，随时欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hello. Welcome to Eden Market Group, the official marketplace run by the continental merchant coalition, supported by the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
你好。欢迎来到乐园团市场，这是由大陆商人联盟运营、乐园团支持的官方市场。

scripts.text: About when we're open.
scripts.translation: 关于营业时间。

scripts.text: About Special Products.
scripts.translation: 关于特殊商品。

scripts.text: About Eden Market Group.
scripts.translation: 关于乐园团市场。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Eden Market Group is a marketplace that contains many different shops.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
乐园团市场是一个包含许多不同商店的市场。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Wednesday is an official holiday designated by the marketplace; most shops are closed on this day.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
周三是市场指定的官方假日；大多数商店在这一天关闭。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
However, depending on the owner's wishes, and the type of items being offered, some shops remain partially open even on the holiday.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
然而，根据店主意愿和所售物品类型，部分商店即使在假日也会部分营业。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
And, some shops offer special items on certain days of the week. Keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
另外，有些商店会在每周的特定日子出售特殊物品。请留意这一点。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Some shops will sell different items on weekends, certain days of the week, or even during certain hours; these items are different than their usual daily items.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
有些商店会在周末、每周的特定日子，甚至特定时间段出售不同的物品；这些物品与它们平时的日常商品不同。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
'Wonderful Friends' and 'Strong Friends' will sell one rare item each weekend.
'Miner's Coalition' will sell the anvil for blacksmithing only on weekends.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
“奇妙好友”和“强力好友”会在每个周末各出售一种稀有物品。
“矿工联盟”只在周末出售用于铁匠工艺的砧板。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
I cannot tell you what items individual shops sell, because they are all different.
Why don't you find out for yourself by visiting often?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
我无法告诉你各个商店具体卖什么，因为每家都不同。
何不经常来逛逛，亲自去发现呢？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
There are many people with the soul of a merchant that would like to sell their items to people in need of such.
Eden Market Group has designated a place for such people to buy and sell.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
有许多拥有商人灵魂的人，希望将他们的物品卖给有需要的人。
乐园团市场为这些人指定了买卖的场所。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We provide the means for goods that would otherwise have been contraband to be bought and sold in a fair and transparent manner, working in conjunction with the merchant coalitions and adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
我们与商人联盟和冒险者合作，提供一种公平且透明的方式，让原本可能属于违禁品的货物得以买卖。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Some people mutter that Eden Market Group is a black market... Haha, what a silly idea...
We are merely a merchant coalition.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
有些人窃窃私语说乐园团市场是黑市……哈哈，真是可笑的想法……
我们只是一个商人联盟。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
A portion of our profits go towards running the Eden Group, an adventurer's guild.
You can sell the loot from your adventures here, and the profits we make go towards providing services that benefit you. We are killing two birds with one stone, really.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
我们的一部分利润用于运营乐园团，这是一个冒险者公会。
你可以在这里出售冒险所得的战利品，我们获得的利润将用于提供惠及你的服务。这真是一举两得。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Keep in mind that limited quantity items will never go on sale!
scripts.translation:
[向导]
请记住，限量物品绝不会打折出售！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Have a good time!
scripts.translation:
[向导]
祝你玩得开心！

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
Do you wish to buy a drink?
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
你想买杯饮料吗？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
祝你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
A drink costs 800z.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
一杯饮料800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
Enjoy it
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
请享用

scripts.text:
[Leria]
I sell coins that I have collected from alternate dimensions.
Purchase whatever catches your eye.
Be warned: they are rather pricey. I had to go through immense trouble in order to procure them.
scripts.translation:
[莱莉娅]
我出售从平行维度收集来的硬币。
请随意挑选你中意的。
警告：它们相当昂贵。为了获取它们，我费了很大的力气。

scripts.text: See what is up for sale.
scripts.translation: 看看有什么在卖

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Leria]
I may not have any stock left since I sell only a handful of items.
scripts.translation:
[莱莉娅]
由于我只出售少量物品，可能已经售罄了。

scripts.text:
[Leria]
Since I scour the world to find the items that I sell, the price is high...
But there are those who buy them anyway.
scripts.translation:
[莱莉娅]
因为我走遍世界寻找这些物品，所以价格很高……
但依然有人购买。

scripts.text:
[Leria]
Well, those who need them must pay the price. Isn't that so?
scripts.translation:
[莱莉娅]
需要它们的人，就得付出相应的代价。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Leria]
Ah... Today is the marketplace holiday.
Come back tomorrow if you need coins.
scripts.translation:
[莱莉娅]
啊……今天是集市休息日。
如果您需要硬币，请明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
Ah, are you the customer that wants 'that' from the ancient castle?
I can only get one per day, but I will sell it.
scripts.translation:
[海姆猎手]
啊，您就是那位想要从古代城堡获取“那个”的顾客吗？
我一天只能弄到一个，但我愿意卖给您。

scripts.text: See the item.
scripts.translation: 查看物品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
There's only one..
It might have been bought by someone else already.
Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[海姆猎手]
只有一个……
可能已经被别人买走了。
请谅解。

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
As you wish.
scripts.translation:
[海姆猎手]
如您所愿。

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
Today is the official market holiday.
I will take a break, too.
scripts.translation:
[海姆猎手]
今天是正式的集市休息日。
我也要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
Do you need keys?
I may have some extra keys for the clock tower?..
scripts.translation:
[泽菲特]
您需要钥匙吗？
我可能有一些钟楼多余的钥匙？..

scripts.text: Buy keys.
scripts.translation: 购买钥匙

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
I gather and sell the keys for the clock tower all by myself...
Even though I scavenge for them all week, there's not a lot available.
They may be sold out already.
scripts.translation:
[泽菲特]
我独自收集并出售钟楼的钥匙……
虽然我整周都在搜寻，但数量并不多。
可能已经卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
You have no need of keys?
Remember that I sell keys here only on weekends.
Just for your information.
scripts.translation:
[泽菲特]
您不需要钥匙吗？
请记住，我只在周末出售钥匙。
仅供参考。

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
I don't have enough keys yet.
Come back after Saturday afternoon.
scripts.translation:
[泽菲特]
我目前的钥匙还不够。
请在周六下午之后再来。

scripts.text:
== Strong Friends == 
From common weapons to priceless jewel-encrusted swords!
Every weapon that you could ever want is here for your perusal.
scripts.translation:
== 强力伙伴 ==
从普通武器到镶嵌珍贵宝石的宝剑！
您想要的所有武器都在这里供您挑选。

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
A limited collection, only available on fiery Friday, Saturday and Sunday!
We offer an assortment of ancient weapons that adventurers have retrieved from dungeons!
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
限量收藏，仅在火红的周五、周六和周日供应！
我们提供冒险者从地下城回收的各种古代武器！

scripts.text: Look at the items.
scripts.translation: 查看物品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
Let us show you the 'Strong Friends' special collection.
If you open the chest and there's nothing there, 
That means the weapon has already been sold.
The spoils go toward people with quick reflexes.
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
让我们向您展示“强力伙伴”的特别收藏。
如果您打开箱子发现里面是空的，
那就意味着武器已经卖出去了。
宝物属于反应快的人。

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
Special weapons sold on weekends!
Come see us anytime!
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
周末出售特别武器！
随时欢迎来光顾！

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
Hello. This is the weapon shop 'Strong Friends'.
We sell weapons that adventurers retrieve from dungeons and in battle, 
roving over the continent.
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
您好。这里是武器店“强力伙伴”。
我们出售冒险者从地下城和战斗中回收的武器，
它们遍布整个大陆。

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
^000000Friday-Saturday-Sunday, a limited weapon collection offered for 3 consecutive days!^000000
Come see us anytime!
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
^000000周五-周六-周日，连续3天供应限量武器收藏！^000000
随时欢迎来光顾！

scripts.text:
[Nelsha]
Hello.
This is 'Strong Friends', where a range of basic weapons are available for your perusal.
scripts.translation:
[内尔莎]
您好。
这里是“强力伙伴”，您可以在此挑选各种基础武器。

scripts.text: Maces, Rods, Knuckles
scripts.translation: 钝器、法杖、拳套

scripts.text: One-Handed Swords, Two-Handed Sword
scripts.translation: 单手剑、双手剑

scripts.text: Bows, Innstruments, Whips
scripts.translation: 弓、乐器、鞭子

scripts.text: Daggers, Katars
scripts.translation: 短剑、拳刃

scripts.text: Axes, Spears
scripts.translation: 斧头、长矛

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nelsha]
Thank you for shopping.
scripts.translation:
[内尔莎]
感谢您的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Nelsha]
I will show you {0}
scripts.translation:
[内尔莎]
我将向您展示{0}

scripts.text:
== Reliable Friends == 
Do you need shields, armor, and sturdy helmets?
You can rely on Reliable Friends!
scripts.translation:
== 可靠伙伴 == 
您需要盾牌、盔甲和坚固的头盔吗？
您可以信赖“可靠伙伴”！

scripts.text:
[Coco]
Do you need sturdy armors to protect your frail body?
Or shields, to block the blows of your enemies?
scripts.translation:
[可可]
您需要坚固的盔甲来保护您娇弱的身躯吗？
或者盾牌，用来抵挡敌人的攻击？

scripts.text: Look at armors.
scripts.translation: 看看盔甲

scripts.text: Look at shields.
scripts.translation: 看看盾牌

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Coco]
Cheap and sturdy armor.
scripts.translation:
[可可]
便宜又结实的盔甲。

scripts.text:
[Coco]
May, or may not, block blows made with reasonable force...
scripts.translation:
[可可]
也许能挡住一些力度合理的攻击...也许不能。

scripts.text:
[Coco]
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[可可]
欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
== Handsome Friends == 
A clothier for someone who loves to dress up!
scripts.translation:
== 帅气伙伴 == 
专为热爱装扮的人准备的服装店！

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Limited item collection, only available on weekends!
Only one item. If you want it, purchase quickly! You know the drill.
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
限量物品收藏，仅限周末供应！
只有一件。如果您想要，请快速购买！您懂的。

scripts.text: See the collection.
scripts.translation: 看看收藏

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Here is our special collection!
If all the chests are empty, that means you are too late!
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
这是我们的特别收藏！
如果所有的箱子都是空的，那就意味着您来晚了！

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
See you again!
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
下次再见！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Do you want to peruse our special collection of items?
But the collection wouldn't be special if you can see them every day, right?
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
您想看看我们的特别物品收藏吗？
但如果每天都能看到，那就不特别了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Come on weekends if you want to see our special collection.
We sell ONE item per day, on ^000000 Saturdays and Sundays^000000.
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
想看我们的特别收藏，请在周末过来。
我们每天只卖一件商品，^000000只在周六和周日^000000。

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Hahahaha.. Aren't you looking forward to the special items soon to be revealed? Muhahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
哈哈哈哈...是不是很期待即将揭晓的特别商品？穆哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Welcome! This is 'Handsome Friends', a clothier that will make you fashionable!
We sell common clothing and hats even on holidays.
scripts.translation:
[拉佩尔特]
欢迎光临！这里是“帅哥朋友”，一家让你变得时尚的服装店！
即使是节假日，我们也出售普通的衣服和帽子。

scripts.text: Clothes and shoes.
scripts.translation: 衣服和长靴

scripts.text: Hats and glasses.
scripts.translation: 帽子和眼镜

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Don't look down on the items just because they are cheap.
They are well-made items from all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[拉佩尔特]
不要因为价格便宜就看不起这些商品。
它们都是来自世界各地的优质商品。

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Fashion comes from matching accessories!
With matching items and a good hat, you can stand on the apex of fashion!
scripts.translation:
[拉佩尔特]
时尚源于配饰的搭配！
搭配好商品并戴上一顶好帽子，你就能站在时尚的巅峰！

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[拉佩尔特]
再见。

scripts.text:
== Meds for Pharmacists == 
We sell assorted potions.

[Days of Operation]
Special potions - Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat
Common potions - every day
scripts.translation:
== 药剂师药品 == 
我们出售各种药水。

[营业日]
特殊药水 - 周一、周二、周四、周五、周六
普通药水 - 每天

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
Potent poisons that will knock you out with one sip, meds that will protect your body and spirit, meds that will temporarily grant supernatural speed.
We have them all.
'Meds for Pharmacists', here to supply you with the medication you need.
scripts.translation:
[首席药剂师]
一口就能让你昏厥的强力毒药，保护身体和精神的药品，暂时赋予超自然速度的药品。
我们应有尽有。
“药剂师药品”，为您提供所需的药品。

scripts.text: Meds, please!
scripts.translation: 我要买药！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
This is what we currently have left.
If there's nothing, it means that we are sold out.
We do not brew potions in large batches. Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[首席药剂师]
这是我们目前剩余的库存。
如果没有，那就意味着我们卖完了。
我们不大量酿造药水，请谅解。

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
Come back if you have questions about the meds.
scripts.translation:
[首席药剂师]
如果您对药品有疑问，请回来询问。

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
Oh, you need potions?
We do not sell common meds. We stick to special potions.
And today is a holiday. We are currently brewing new potions.
scripts.translation:
[首席药剂师]
哦，您需要药水？
我们不卖普通药品。我们只坚持卖特殊药水。
今天是节假日。我们正在酿造新的药水。

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
I will show you a collection of our superior potions if you come back tomorrow, okay?
Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[首席药剂师]
如果您明天回来，我会向您展示我们的高级药水收藏，好吗？
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Johanna]
Welcome to 'Meds for Pharmacists'.
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[约翰娜]
欢迎光临“药剂师药品”。
您需要什么？

Most shops in the Eden Market Group do not operate on holidays.

[Jeffrey]
Everyone assumes that I am the cook here. I'm not! I'm just here to collect on the debt that the restaurant owner owes me!
scripts.translation:
[杰弗里]
大家都以为我是这里的厨师。我不是！我只是来讨回餐馆老板欠我的债！

scripts.text:
[Jeffrey]
I made a few dishes just to shut up the complaining customers, but this is getting out of hand!
scripts.translation:
[杰弗里]
我只是为了让那些抱怨的顾客闭嘴才做了几道菜，但这简直失控了！

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
... The new cook makes amazing food, but apparently he's pretty lazy.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
... 新厨师做的菜很美味，但听说他挺懒的。

scripts.text:
[Panel]
This restaurant opened only recently, but it became really popular after they hired a new cook.
scripts.translation:
[面板]
这家餐馆刚开张不久，但在聘请了新厨师后变得非常受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Matina]
What is it? Are you going to order? Forget it. Look at the line-up.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂娜]
怎么了？你要点餐吗？算了。看看这排队的队伍吧。

scripts.text:

Ah. I am going to wait a little more, but if I am still not served, I will leave.
scripts.translation:
[露西]
啊。我再等一会儿，但如果还是没人理我，我就走了。

scripts.text:

I heard that the owner of this restaurant went on a trip to a faraway land, and the new cook is running this place. I heard that his cooking skill is amazing.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉]
我听说这家餐馆的老板去远方旅行了，现在是由新厨师在经营。听说他的厨艺非常惊人。

scripts.text:
[Lana]
I came two days ago, yesterday, and today too. The pasta they serve here is amazing. The only problem is that it's so hard to order here.
scripts.translation:
[拉娜]
我前天、昨天和今天都来了。这里的意面非常美味。唯一的问题是，在这里点餐太难了。

scripts.text:
[Rahoul]
I have been waiting for hours already and the cook is still not taking orders. Ah, I am so hungry that I might drop dead.
scripts.translation:
[拉乌尔]
我已经等了好几个小时了，厨师还没开始点餐。啊，我饿得快要死掉了。

scripts.text:
[Drunk]
Hey, bring more wine...
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
嘿，再拿点酒来...

scripts.text:

I am going to talk to the owner once he comes back from his trip. Tell him to fire his employees there at the back.
So many customers milling about, and they aren't even serving anyone

[不耐烦的顾客]
等老板旅行回来，我一定要找他谈谈。让他把后面那些员工都开除。
这么多顾客在排队，居然没人接待。

scripts.translation:

我是斯兰的同事，我喜欢在这家店当清洁工。我可以想偷懒就偷懒，照样能拿到工资。

scripts.text:
[Thrann]
I spend hours here drinking coffee in peace, though I am technically at work, pretending to clean. They don't even kick me out.
scripts.translation:
[斯兰]
我花好几个小时在这里安静地喝咖啡。虽然名义上是在工作，假装在打扫，但他们也不赶我走。

今天休息。

We will buy at a reasonable price.
scripts.translation:
[奥罗拉]
我们会以合理的价格收购。

scripts.text:
[Aurora]
We deal in products like gold, phlogopite, agate and turquoise.
But uncut gemstones are rare.
scripts.translation:

我们经营黄金、云母、玛瑙和绿松石等产品。
但未切割的宝石原石很稀有。

scripts.text:
[Aurora]
We procure them from mines, but the supply is limited~
Our stock is replenished every week, so if you time it just right.. maybe? Haha.
scripts.translation:
[奥罗拉]
我们从矿山采购，但供应有限~
我们的库存每周补充一次，所以如果您时机刚好...也许？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Aurora]
Aw, sorry that you came by today.
Our Market Group is not open on Wednesdays.
We need time to restock and check our inventory levels, and of course, time to rest up.
scripts.translation:
[奥罗拉]
哎呀，抱歉您今天来了。
我们的市场小组周三不营业。
我们需要时间补货、检查库存水平，当然，也需要时间休息。

scripts.text:
[Aurora]
If you come by tomorrow, we would be happy to offer you our range of products that will make your weapons more powerful!
scripts.translation:
[奥罗拉]
如果您明天来，我们将很乐意为您提供能让您的武器更强大的产品系列！

Reagents for alchemy and
ingredients to make medication
All sold here~

[Days of Operation]

scripts.translation:

炼金术的原料
以及制作药品的材料
这里应有尽有~

Reagents for alchemy!
We sell Alcohol, Karvodailnirol, and Detrimindexta!
We sell 20 each, per day!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 戴]
炼金术的原料！
我们出售酒精、卡勒波迪药水和帝特立米药水！
每天每种各出售20个！

scripts.text: Look at the reagents.

scripts.text:
[Dye the Alchemist]
Not sure if we have any left!
If not, everything is sold out!
They may be a bit expensive, but easy consumption... well, you know what I am talking about. Yeah?
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 戴]
不确定还有没有库存！
如果没有的话，那就全部卖光了！
虽然可能有点贵，但很容易消耗...嗯，你知道我指的是什么。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dye the Alchemist]
Come by tomorrow, we brew reagents every day!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 戴]
明天再来吧，我们每天都酿造原料！

scripts.text:
[Dye the Alchemist]
We are closed on Wednesdays~
Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 戴]
周三休息~
明天再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Earl the Alchemist]
Ingredients to make reagents, potions, 
and elemental stones for magical experiements, all sold here!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
制作原料、药水
以及用于魔法实验的元素石的材料，
这里都有出售！

scripts.text:
[Earl the Alchemist]
Not sure how much remains of our stock, since our supply is limited, but...
Looking for something?
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
由于供应有限，不确定还剩多少库存，但是...
您在找什么吗？

scripts.text: Look at ingredients.
scripts.translation: 查看材料

scripts.text: Look at elemental stones.
scripts.translation: 查看元素石

scripts.text: Cancel.

Immortal Hearts, Stems, and many other ingredients from various dungeons
offered here at a reasonable price
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
不死心脏、茎类，以及来自各个迷宫的许多其他材料，
这里都以合理的价格出售

scripts.text:
[Earl the Alchemist]
If you don't see anything, that means everything is sold out.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
如果您没看到任何商品，那就意味着全部卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Earl the Alchemist]
Stardust, and Star Crumb here.
Not sure if we have any left.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
这里有星尘和星星的角。
不确定还有没有库存。

scripts.text:
[Earl the Alchemist]
Come again!
Keep in mind that we don't open on Wednesdays, because that's when we have items shipped in!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
欢迎再次光临！
请记住，我们周三不营业，因为那是我们进货的日子！

scripts.text:
[Earl the Alchemist]
Wednesday is a holiday.
Come back tomorrow if there's anything you want to buy.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士 厄尔]
周三是休息日。
如果您想买什么，明天再来吧。

Wolf blood and Petite's Tails!

狼血和毕帝特地龙的尾巴！

除节假日外每天营业

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
Welcome.
If you need cooking ingredients, you have come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
欢迎光临。
如果您需要烹饪材料，这里就是正确的地方。

scripts.text: Advanced cooking ingredients.

scripts.text: Sauces and spies.

scripts.text: Sell items.

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
Not sure how many we have left.
Well,^4d4dffif you see nothing, that means everything is sold out^000000.
Peruse at your pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
不确定还剩多少。
嗯，^4d4dff如果您没看到任何商品，那就意味着全部卖光了^000000。
请随意挑选。

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
Sauces and spices from all over the world..
I am the person to go to if you want cooking ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
来自世界各地的酱汁和香料。
如果您需要烹饪材料，我就是您要找的人。

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
If it's a product I deal in, I will purchase them from you at a reasonable price.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
只要是经营的商品，我都会以合理的价格向您收购。

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
You might know this already, but I will say it anyways.
We have limited supplies. Our ingredients are often sold out if you hesitate for too long.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
您可能已经知道了，但我还是要说一下。
我们的库存有限。如果您犹豫太久，材料经常就会卖光。

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
Just saying.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
只是提醒一下。

scripts.text:
[Manbok]
Not open on Wednesdays.
We restock today. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[万福]
周三不营业。
今天补货。请明天再来。

scripts.text:
== Ma-Ma-Ma-Ma == 
 == Magical Store == 
Ingredients and gems for magic, 
Specializing in magic scrolls

[Days of Operation]
Some items not sold on holidays
But open every day.
scripts.translation:
== 魔法商店 == 
魔法材料和宝石，
专营魔法卷轴

[营业时间]
部分商品在节假日不销售
但每天都营业。

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
Welcome.
This is Ma-Ma-Ma-Ma the Magical Store, run by the Ma brothers, helping non-Mages use magic.
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
欢迎光临。
这里是马多哈魔法商店，由马氏兄弟经营，帮助非魔法师使用魔法。

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
We sell magic scrolls and gems.
Anything particular that you are looking for?
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
我们出售魔法卷轴和宝石。
您有什么特别要找的吗？

scripts.text: Look at items.
scripts.translation: 看看商品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
Blue, red, yellow gems. Magic scrolls like Meteor Storm, Stormgust, Lord of Vermillion...
^4d4dffIf there is nothing, it means everything is sold out^000000, please be aware.
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
蓝色、红色、黄色宝石。像陨石术、风暴、朱红领主这样的魔法卷轴...
^4d4dff如果没有看到任何商品，那就意味着全部卖光了^000000，请留意。

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
Making magic scrolls is interesting work.
Magic scrolls also help a lot of non-mage adventurers by allowing them to use magic they don't know.
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
制作魔法卷轴是一项有趣的工作。
魔法卷轴也能帮助很多非魔法师冒险者使用他们不会的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
But there's a limit to how many scrolls I can scribe per week, so they sometimes run out.
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
但我每周能抄写的卷轴数量有限，所以有时会卖光。

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
Oh, a customer?
Today is a holiday. We only sell basic magical ingredients today. No scrolls. Is that okay?
We have blue gems, points, and runestones..
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
哦，有顾客？
今天是节假日。今天只出售基础魔法材料。没有卷轴。这样可以吗？
我们有蓝色宝石、点数和符文石。

scripts.text: Look at items.
scripts.translation: 看看商品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
We try to be stocked up as much as possible but we may have run out.
If you see nothing, that means everything is sold out.
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
我们尽量备足库存，但可能会卖光。
如果没有看到任何商品，那就意味着全部卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Madoha]
Yellow and red gems, and magic scrolls, are sold on other days, 
So come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[马多哈]
黄色和红色宝石，以及魔法卷轴，在其他日子出售，
所以请明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Magiha]
Welcome tooooooo.
Ma-Ma-Ma-Ma, the Magical Store.
We sell resistance potions to raise your elemental resistance..
scripts.translation:
[玛吉哈]
欢迎光临。
马多哈魔法商店。
我们出售抗性药水，提高您的元素抗性。

scripts.text: Look at items.
scripts.translation: 看看商品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Magiha]
We brew and sell four types of resistance potions that ward against water, wind, earth, or fire.
If you see nothing, that means all the potions are sold out.
scripts.translation:
[玛吉哈]
我们酿造并出售四种抗性药水，分别抵御水、风、土或火。
如果没有看到任何商品，那就意味着药水全部卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Magiha]
Come again!
scripts.translation:
[玛吉哈]
欢迎再来！

scripts.text:
[Magiha]
Today is a holiday! I did not brew any potions today...
Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[玛吉哈]
今天是节假日！我今天没有酿造药水...
请明天再来。

Moving in soon
scripts.translation:
== 世界树祝福 == 
即将开业

scripts.text:
== Exotic Plants == 
Poisonous plants sold.
Days of Operation: always
scripts.translation:
== 奇异植物 == 
出售有毒植物。
营业时间：全天

scripts.text:
[Hwaran]
Welcome to Exotic Plants.
I deal with plants that are shockingly bitter when you chew on them.
Will you look around?
scripts.translation:
[华兰]
欢迎光临奇异植物店。
我专门经营那些嚼起来苦得惊人的植物。
您要看看吗？

scripts.text: Look at items.
scripts.translation: 看看商品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hwaran]
Please shower them with affection, though they are poisonous plants.
I selected these babies from the farm myself. Very potent when made into meds.
scripts.translation:
[华兰]
虽然它们是有毒植物，但请多多疼爱它们吧。
这些小家伙是我亲自从农场挑选的。制成药物时效果非常强效。

scripts.text:
[Hwaran]
So many frequent customers to my store are from the assassin's guild, surprisingly enough. I don't know why.
Obviously they must be peace-loving people at heart, since they are so fond of plants.
scripts.translation:
[华兰]
令人惊讶的是，我店里有很多常客都来自刺客公会。我也不知道为什么。
显然他们内心一定是热爱和平的人，毕竟他们这么喜欢植物。

scripts.text:

Specializing in items for Cute Pets
We introduce you to beasts you can mount, and companions you can hunt with
[Days of Operation]
Always!
scripts.translation:
== 你和我 == 
专营可爱宠物用品
为您介绍可以骑乘的野兽，以及可以一起狩猎的伙伴
[营业时间]
全天！

Welcome. Would you like to rent a Dragon?
scripts.translation:
[训练师 盖克]
欢迎光临。您想租一条龙吗？

scripts.text:

Welcome. Would you like to rent a Gryphon?
scripts.translation:
[训练师 盖克]
欢迎光临。您想租一只狮鹫兽吗？

scripts.text:
[Gecko the Trainer]
I'm here to provide Rune Knights and Royal Guards with riding creatures.
scripts.translation:

我负责为卢恩骑士和皇家卫士提供坐骑。

scripts.text: No

I see. Then have a great day.
scripts.translation:

明白了。祝您度过愉快的一天。

Please learn how to ride a Dragon first.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 盖克]
请先学会骑龙。

scripts.text:
[Gecko the Trainer]
You already have a Dragon.
scripts.translation:

您已经拥有一条龙了。

您已经拥有一只狮鹫兽了。

scripts.text:

Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 盖克]
请先下马。

scripts.text:
[Tete]
'You and Me', we love animals!
We are open 24/7 to provide you with all the items your Cute Pets and companion animals need!
Do you need items for your Pet?
scripts.translation:
[泰特]
“你和我”，我们热爱动物！
我们全天候营业，为您提供可爱宠物和伙伴动物所需的所有物品！
您需要宠物的物品吗？

scripts.text: Look at items.
scripts.translation: 看看商品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Tete]
We have a diverse selection of food for Pets.
We have incubators, too!
scripts.translation:
[泰特]
我们有种类丰富的宠物食物。
还有孵化器哦！

scripts.text:
[Tete]
Thank you for coming by~!
scripts.translation:
[泰特]
谢谢您的光临~！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
嗯...
在您解除战狼之前，
是无法租猎鹰的！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Do you need a Falcon?
You can rent your own
trusty bird of prey for a
fee of just {0} zeny~
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
您需要猎鹰吗？
您可以支付{0} Zeny的费用，
租用一只可靠的猛禽~

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Young fool!
Falcons can only
be used by Hunters
and Snipers, capish?
...Heh heh, jealous?
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
年轻的小子！
猎鹰只有猎人
和神射手才能使用，懂吗？
...嘿嘿，羡慕吗？

scripts.text: Rent Falcon.
scripts.translation: 租用猎鹰

scripts.text: Buy a Falcon Flute.
scripts.translation: 购买猎鹰笛

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
嗯...
在您解除战狼之前，
是无法租猎鹰的！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
What is this?
You don't have
enough zeny?!
You better start
hunting money
instead of monsters~
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
这是什么？
你的Zeny不够吗？！
你最好去赚点钱，
而不是只打怪~

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Gosh~
Go learn how to
manage a Falcon
first! I can't rent one
to you if you can't
handle it, you know.
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
哎呀~
先去学学怎么驯养猎鹰吧！
如果你连它都控制不了，
我是没法租给你的，知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Um...
You already have
a Falcon. It's right
there, can't you see it?
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
嗯...
你已经有一只猎鹰了。
它就在旁边，你看不见吗？

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
With a magical Flute, you can call your Falcon from anywhere!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
有了神奇的笛子，你可以从任何地方召唤你的猎鹰！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
It's marvelous, isn't it? Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
是不是很神奇？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Why I'm selling these Falcon Flutes?
It's because I have no clue how they work.
Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
我为什么卖这些猎鹰笛？
因为我自己也不知道它们是怎么工作的。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Of course, you'll need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000.
I don't have the Skill, so I don't know how to handle Falcons.
As it's for now, I may never have a Falcon.
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
当然，你需要^ff0000猎鹰精通^000000技能。
我没有这个技能，所以不知道怎么驯养猎鹰。
就目前而言，我可能永远都不会有猎鹰了。

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
But I can't give you one for free!
I have to make money since I also need to eat!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
但我不能免费送你一个！
我也得赚钱，毕竟我也得吃饭！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
If you need a Falcon Flute I will sell them for 12,500 zeny. Or is that too expensive?
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
如果你需要猎鹰笛，我会以12,500 Zeny的价格出售。或者你觉得太贵了？

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
For Rangers, however, I have a special price of 10,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
不过，对于游侠，我有10,000 Zeny的特价！

scripts.text: Don't buy one.
scripts.translation: 不买

scripts.text: Buy a Falcon Flute.
scripts.translation: 购买猎鹰笛

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
That's too bad. If you need one, come back!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
真遗憾。如果你需要，欢迎再来！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
As I can see you already have a Falcon Flute!
Don't worry, my young friend, once you've purchased the Falcon Flute you won't need to do so again
since the Falcon Flute won't disappear upon usage, isn't that great?
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
我看你已经有猎鹰笛了！
别担心，年轻的朋友，一旦你购买了猎鹰笛，就不需要再买了，
因为猎鹰笛使用后不会消失，这不是很棒吗？

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Here, take this flute.
With it you can whistle for your Falcon from anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
拿着，这是笛子。
有了它，你可以从任何地方吹哨召唤你的猎鹰。

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Just a reminder.
You need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000 in order to use it!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
提醒一下。
你需要^ff0000猎鹰精通^000000技能才能使用它！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
I'm sorry but you don't have enough money to buy a Falcon Flute, please come back when you have more money!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
很抱歉，你的钱不够买猎鹰笛，请攒够钱再来！

scripts.text:
[Mist the Hunter]
Look at other items in our store.
We may be offering a new Pet Items soon~
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[猎人 米斯特]
看看我们店里的其他商品吧。
我们很快可能会推出新的宠物道具~
哈哈哈！
